summary: Phase 1: Foundation successfully completed. Initialized Laravel 11.57 and Filament v3.3, integrated all 7 mandatory packages behind service adapters with live System Health diagnostics, built multi-tenancy and branch scoping with Unicode slugs, discovered and generated manifests for all 50 modules with dependency enforcement and 8 business presets, scaffolded 11 Filament role-based panels, built Module Center and Setup Wizard pages, configured Spatie RBAC with 14 roles and demo users, and verified with 15 passing tests (83 assertions).
